release.name: 9700E150_20261118v4
release.label: 20261118v4
release.title: IC-9700 E 1.50 + transverter + ICAP decoders & PSKReporter (20261118v4)
features: Transverter support: 8 slots (TRV1–TRV8, RF / IF on 2 m, 70 cm or 23 cm), RF shown up to 122 GHz
Separate active transverter for MAIN and SUB (SET > Transverter > MAIN Active / SUB Active); DUAL watch shows each receiver's own RF
MAIN/SUB exchange swaps the transverter selection together with the bands
SAT mode: transmit settings (power cap, TX delay, PTT inhibit) follow SUB Active; normal mode: MAIN Active
Per-transverter maximum TX power, TX delay (up to 300 ms, all modes) and PTT inhibit
CI-V frequency read/write in RF terms (6-byte BCD above 1.4 GHz, as IC-905)
Scope Set > Scope dB/div: 10 / 6 / 3 / 1 dB per division for spectrum and waterfall, noise floor anchored automatically (MAIN and SUB independently)
SD-card apps: MENU > SET > Apps (\IC-9700\Apps\)
Custom A/B bootloader: hold POWER while connecting DC (~5 s) to boot the other firmware slot
Opening screen shows 'customized by Dawid SQ6EMM - 20261118v4'; the radio's version text stays official 1.50
SD-card decoder apps (ICAP): Q65, FT8, JT4 and PI4 digital-mode decoders on the DECODE screen, WSJT-X-style output (plus a WSPR decoder)

Automatic PSKReporter spotting: every decode is reported when your own callsign and locator are set on the radio (the firmware carries no personal data; spot frequency is the true on-air RF, transverter-aware)
Experimental period-aligned beacon TX inside the decoder apps - for now enabled via the app's .CFG file; on-radio button activation comes in a later release
Download the matching SD-apps bundle on the patcher page and copy it to the radio's \Apps\ folder
